prompt:
Both are white women in their early twenties who look young and fresh-faced: bare, natural-looking skin with almost no makeup, soft natural brows, softer rounder features rather than sharp editorial bone structure, relaxed casual styling. Adults, but youthful and girl-next-door rather than polished high-fashion models.

LEFT: golden blonde hair piled into a high messy bun.
RIGHT: dark brunette with a blunt shoulder-length bob, tucked behind one ear.

LEFT wears an oversized blue-and-white vertical striped poplin shirt worn loose and untucked with sleeves pushed up, cream high-waisted straight-leg jeans, dark brown loafers, a small brown leather shoulder bag, black oval sunglasses, gold hoop earrings.
RIGHT wears a light-blue fitted poplin shirt tucked into cream high-waisted straight-leg trousers, a rust-red fine-knit jumper draped over the shoulders and knotted at the chest, tan loafers, a small dark-brown top-handle bag, black oval sunglasses.

Behind them, floor-to-ceiling white panelled built-in wardrobe doors filling the entire wall, with slim matte-black vertical bar handles. Pale grey low-pile carpet visible across the bottom of the frame.

Vertical photo shot on an iPhone. The camera is DEAD STRAIGHT ON, perfectly perpendicular to the wall behind them, lens at chest height, absolutely no tilt, no angle, no perspective skew — a flat, front-on framing like a mirror photo. The two women stand side by side with a small gap between them, shoulders square to the camera, both facing the lens directly. They FILL THE FRAME: the tops of their heads sit close to the top edge and their shoes sit close to the bottom edge, only a small margin above and below, and they span most of the width. Full body, head to shoes, nothing cropped off. Bright natural daylight, sharp, slight grain, authentic social-media photo. No text, no captions, no watermark, no logo, no graphics, no borders.
